name: handed-a-key
goal: Find out whether the slowness is me or the box, whether I am allowed to be using it this much, and whether there is anything I should do differently.
note: Read-only, against the live daemon. This caller is walking the OPERATOR's dashboard, because today there is no other one and there is only one credential — which is itself the thing this run is here to measure.

steps.name: the-front-door
steps.promise: Somebody who was handed a key can tell whether this page is for them.

steps.name: is-the-box-alright
steps.promise: I can tell whether the machine is having a problem, without knowing how it works.

steps.name: what-am-i-allowed-to-call
steps.promise: I can see which models I may ask for, by the names I would put in my editor.

steps.name: which-of-these-callers-is-me
steps.promise: I can find myself among the callers, and see what my key is allowed.

steps.name: my-own-calls
steps.promise: I can see what I have been asking for, separately from everybody else.

steps.name: did-my-calls-work
steps.promise: I can tell a request of mine that failed from one that was merely slow.

steps.name: was-it-me-this-morning
steps.promise: I can look at the time it felt slow and tell whether my own calls were the problem.

steps.name: the-model-my-editor-uses
steps.promise: I can see whether the model I ask for is healthy, without being asked to manage it.
